# SlashGear

> > SlashGear delivers technology news, automotive coverage, and practical how-to guides covering everything from military drones to gaming browsers.

SlashGear is a technology and automotive publication featuring in-depth articles on cutting-edge military tech like Anduril's Fury autonomous aircraft, consumer electronics, vehicle features, and step-by-step tutorials for optimizing software and hardware. The site covers both emerging technologies and practical user guides for everyday tech enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Autonomous aircraft and military drones
- Anduril Technologies
- Fury AAV (Advanced Autonomous Vehicle)
- U.S. Air Force technology
- Opera GX gaming browser
- RAM and CPU management
- Toyota Prius and hybrid vehicles
- Subaru Auto Vehicle Hold (AVH)
- Video wallpapers for Windows and Mac
- MQ-9 Reaper and RQ-4 Global Hawk
- Fighter jet technology
- Resource limiting and browser optimization
- Tech newsletters and subscriptions
- Automotive features and acronyms

## How-To Guides & Tutorials

- [How To Limit RAM And CPU Usage In Opera GX](https://www.slashgear.com/912121/how-to-limit-ram-and-cpu-usage-in-opera-gx/): Tutorial for managing RAM and CPU resources in Opera GX gaming browser
- [How To Use A Video As A Wallpaper On Windows Or Mac](https://www.slashgear.com/1597715/how-to-use-video-as-wallpaper-windows-mac/): Guide for setting video wallpapers on Windows and macOS systems
- [AVH Subaru: What Is It & What Does The Acronym Stand For?](https://www.slashgear.com/1817989/avh-subaru-meaning-expalined-how-turn-off-feature/): Explanation of Subaru's Auto Vehicle Hold feature and disable instructions
